0.0: Hello, traveler. What kind of a story would you like to hear from me, #p2101008#? \r\n#L0# #b The story of #p2101001#
0.1: #p2101001#!? You know #p2101001#?! How is he?! I hope he's doing all right without me... So, #p2101001# sent you. Thank you. There's no way for me to check up on #p2101001# from the palace. I was so worried.\r\n#L0# #b #p2101001# is really worried about you, too.
0.2: I see... It's only natural, since he can't contact his only sister. Could you tell #p2101001# that I'm doing all right in here?

yes.0: Thank you. Can you get this letter to #b#p2101001##k in #r#m260000200##k? The least I can do is send a letter if I can't visit in person...

no.0: You must be really busy... But there's nothing I can do from here. At least I know how #p2101001#'s doing now, but...

1.0: Hello, traveler. Did you see my sister? What? This is a letter from her?! I was so worried, because I heard that the queen is quite scary... I am so glad she's doing all right!

yes.0: Based on this letter, it seems my sister likes telling the queen stories. But at least she's safe. Thank you very much for sending my regards.

npc.0: I don't think you've met with #b#p2101001##k yet. He should be around #b#m260000200##k.

item.0: You didn't meet with my sister yet? She's in the palace.

lost.0: Oh no... You lost the letter? Well, it's not hard for me to write another one. Here you go. Please give this to #b#p2101001##k.

QuestInfo.name: A Letter From the Sister
QuestInfo.1: #p2101008#, the older sister of #p2101001#. #p2101001# will want to know how his sister is doing. You should deliver the letter she wrote to #b#p2101001##k.
QuestInfo.2: #p2101001# seemed ecstatic to receive a letter from #p2101008#. He must have been concerned that the horrendous queen might really give her a hard time.
